messages:
Izzy (People Ops): @here All-hands this Thurs 9:00 AM PT. Short agenda below + Q form: https://forms.gle/redwood-ah-4812 — drop anything urgent by Wed 4 PM.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Opening notes: company momentum + one ask on hiring focus areas. Keeping remarks to 6 mins.
Rina Patel (Security): I'll present the updated retention & access policy changes (why we tweaked default roles). Policy draft will be uploaded Tue.
Priya Desai (Product): I'll share the Dedicated beta readiness checklist and a brief on expected performance numbers (7 mins).
Marco Chen (Eng): I'll walk through the recent autoscaler incident RCA and the two fixes we deployed (5 mins).
Ella (Customer Success): Request: would like 3–4 minutes to showcase a customer success story for the beta workflow. Confirmed one customer.
townhall-bot: :bell: Reminder scheduled — All-hands Thurs 9:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent.
Izzy (People Ops): Format: 35 min total. 10 min exec/product, 8 min eng, 5 min customer, 12 min live Q&A. Recording + transcript will be posted in #all-hands.
Priya Desai (Product): Draft deck uploaded: https://redwood.share/drive/ah-dedicated-v2. Please add feedback directly on the slides.
Marco Chen (Eng): Incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/eng/incidents/2026-autoscaler. TL;DR: runaway backlog during a spike -> fixed threshold logic + added top-level alert.
Rina Patel (Security): Note: default role change reduces cross-team log access; Private deployments unaffected. Will post FAQ for sales.
Izzy (People Ops): Please add 1–2 top Qs here or in the form by Wed 4 PM so we can prioritize. If you need captions, DM me.
Izzy (People Ops): (after meeting) Recording: https://redwood.co/recordings/4812345678-townhall. Key takeaways below.
Izzy (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated beta on-track; pilot invites next week. 2) Default retention/access tweak to improve data minimization; FAQ & exceptions path documented. 3) Autoscaler fixes deployed; monitoring dashboards added. 4) CS to publish beta onboarding notes and sizing guidance. Actions and owners in follow-up doc.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Good, actionable meeting. Leads: please surface one measurable deliverable for your area in 2 weeks.
Ella (Customer Success): Customer vignette went well; they asked about on-prem sizing and SLA language. I'll surface details in follow-up.
Izzy (People Ops): Follow-up doc and action owners posted to #all-hands — closing. :white_check_mark:
